summary.text: Han Khon To is the Republican candidate for the open New York State Senate District 12 seat in Queens.

A refugee who arrived in New York City in 1980 and later worked as a phlebotomist at Kings County Hospital, he previously ran for this seat in 2024, losing to Michael Gianaris, and for State Assembly District 35 in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Han Khon To arrived in New York City as a refugee in 1980, according to a 2024 QNS report, which also says he worked as a phlebotomist at Kings County Hospital.
In 2020 he was the Republican candidate for State Assembly District 35, losing to incumbent Jeffrion Aubry.
He ran unopposed in the 2024 Republican primary for State Senate District 12 and lost the general election to incumbent Michael Gianaris on November 5, 2024.
He is again the Republican candidate for District 12 in 2026, after the Republican primary was canceled.
The 2024 QNS report noted that he had no campaign website or social media presence.
